name: Authorized admin opens and safely cancels a Google Sheets edit
covers: customer, case, contact, task, document navigation
description: Checks an authorized admin can open the form for an existing sheet record, see protected fields, and cancel without changing the sheet.
steps: Sign in with the authorized Google account
Wait until Google Sheets data is loaded
Visit all five data tabs and confirm each table uses its matching sheet
Return to the customer register, open a company name and confirm every registry field is present and read only
Close the company profile
Open the edit form for a visible record
Confirm the record identifier is read only
Cancel the form without saving
expected: The edit form shows the selected record and read-only identifier; cancel closes the form and leaves the source data unchanged.

name: Google Sheets access failure shows the failing stage
description: Checks a failed source connection identifies whether authentication, API access, or schema validation failed without exposing secrets.
steps: Sign in while Google Sheets access is unavailable
Wait for the data request and connection status to settle
expected: The app distinguishes a connection or credential failure from a header mismatch and does not show Sandbox records.

name: Draft company name controls the Google Search link
description: Checks the customer edit header uses the current synthetic company name for Google Search while preserving editable form values.
steps: Use only an isolated synthetic-data test app containing SYN-TEST-CUST-001, not production customer records
Sign in with the authorized test account and open the edit form for SYN-TEST-CUST-001
Change the company name to บริษัท ทดสอบ เอสเอ็มอี จำกัด without saving
Inspect the header link: its Google query must match the trimmed name, its target must be _blank and its rel must contain noopener noreferrer
Change the name to บริษัท ทดสอบ A&B จำกัด and confirm the link query updates without changing the input or closing the form
Open the header link using only this synthetic company name, verify Google opens in a new tab with the matching query, and return to confirm the unsaved form values are unchanged
Clear the company name and confirm the search link is hidden
Cancel without saving
expected: Only the customer edit header has the Google Search link; it follows the current Thai draft name, safely encodes special characters, hides when blank and never writes data during this test.

name: Manual Google contact-search mark persists for one synthetic customer
covers: stable customer ID with duplicate company names
existing company details and search link
description: Checks manual marking and unmarking on the isolated synthetic sheet without affecting a duplicate-name customer.
steps: Use only the synthetic test app and synthetic customer IDs SYN-TEST-CUST-001 and SYN-TEST-CUST-002; never run writes against production
Sign in and open the customer register; confirm both names have a separate checkbox labelled seach google ไม่พบข้อมูลช่องทางติดต่อ
Use Space on the checkbox for SYN-TEST-CUST-001 and wait for confirmed success
Refresh and reopen the app in a second view; confirm only SYN-TEST-CUST-001 is checked
Open the company profile and confirm the new status is read only; open and cancel the editor to confirm the Google Search link still exists
Uncheck SYN-TEST-CUST-001 and refresh; confirm the mark is removed and neither company gained changed contact details
expected: The selected synthetic customer retains its mark after refresh and in another view, then retains the unmarked result; the duplicate-name row is unchanged and checkbox interaction opens no dialog or Google tab.

name: Failed contact-search write restores the previously confirmed mark
description: Injects an update failure and verifies the checkbox returns to its previous confirmed state.
steps: Use only the isolated synthetic test app with SYN-TEST-CUST-001
Sign in, note the current confirmed checkbox state and toggle it
Wait for the injected failure and inspect the customer register
Refresh and verify the source state is unchanged
expected: A visible error is shown, no success is claimed, and the checkbox and sheet remain at the previous confirmed state.
